title: Buying & access
description: Unlock a paid Kahana hub: find it, complete Stripe checkout, reopen it later, and understand one-time vs monthly. plus adult gates and why Aura isn’t payment.
content:
Buying on Kahana unlocks access to a hub’s digital artifacts under your account. This page walks browse → paywall → checkout → “where is my content?” and clears up one-time vs monthly, adult gates, and Aura ≠ payment.

Primary action: Open Library · stuck? Support (/support in the app).

What you’re buying

Access to a hub (its digital artifacts) under your Kahana account, not a separate download store in most cases.

Find something to buy

  • Library. Filter free vs paid, price, category.
  • A creator’s profile.
  • A direct hub link (/hub/:id).

Browse without an account

  • Most non-adult public hubs: yes, you can browse.
  • Purchase and adult access: you need to be logged in.

Checkout steps

  1. Sign in or sign up.
  2. Open the hub → you’ll see the paywall if you don’t have access yet.
  3. Complete Stripe checkout.
  4. Access unlocks when payment succeeds (or when a free trial starts, if the creator offered one).

One-time vs monthly

TypeWhat you get
One-timeOngoing access to that hub (typical “lifetime” access to the hub)
MonthlyAccess while the subscription stays active
Free trialOnly if the creator enabled it

Where to open it later

  • Use the same hub URL, or find it in your library / saved hubs as the product UI offers.
  • You must be logged into the same account that paid.

Adult hubs

  • May be filtered from default Library.
  • Login + date-of-birth age verify (18+) before access.

Rules: Adult content & age verification. Overview: Trust.

Payments & safety

  • Processed by Stripe (Connect). Kahana doesn’t store full card numbers.
  • Issues: in-app Support (/support) and the Terms in the product.

Refunds

Payments and disputes follow Stripe and Kahana’s published terms / refund policy. Don’t assume a fixed refund window unless it’s stated in those policies. Start with /support if you need help.

Aura is not payment

Aura is a daily give budget for recognition. It does not unlock paywalls. See How Aura works.

Quick facts

  • Checkout: Stripe on the hub paywall.
  • Access: tied to your Kahana user after success.
  • Types: one-time · monthly · optional trial.
  • Adult: auth + age verify.
  • Support: /support.

What’s next
